origin: docx-eval; measured on a real thesis template that is not redistributed with this dataset, then rebuilt as synthetic figure paragraphs (style ac, line=300 auto, mark 14pt, run 12pt SimSun)

word: an inline image alone on its line = image height + effectExtent top + bottom + (multiple-1) x the single line of the RUN font; no descent under it (Latin and SimSun runs alike)
the paragraph mark's size does not matter: mark 12pt and 14pt give identical Bottom positions
effectExtent adds fully: t1.5+b0.95 -> +2.4pt, t1.5+b1.25 -> +2.65pt, independent of image height (72/170/227pt)
SimSun runs measure like Times New Roman here, so the 1.7pt seen in the measured thesis was effectExtent minus the mark-size overshoot, not a font descent
